selected_evidence.requirement: Shared writable directory with protection against deleting files owned by other users
selected_evidence.summary: Shows /srv/drop as root:root mode 1777; nobody and daemon both wrote files, while cross-user deletion failed with Operation not permitted.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID d3dfad9f-1c03-4b70-8000-000000000000, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 88618636-13fd-4960-8000-000000000000, and successful post-restart permission and behavioral checks.

commands.command: id; cat /etc/redhat-release 2>/dev/null || cat /etc/issue; uname -r; if [ -e /srv/drop ]; then ls -ld /srv/drop; stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U group=%G type=%F' /srv/drop; else echo '/srv/drop: absent'; fi; for u in nobody daemon; do id "$u" 2>/dev/null || echo "$u: absent"; done
